chapter: South America and back in New York
title: Harlem breakfast dances
summary: He describes breakfast dances running from three or four until morning, made by Harlem's beautiful chorus girls.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah, right. But what about, well let's say, the breakfast dances. What were they like?
Yeah, when did they start? Did they start at midnight, or ---

Well, they'd start around three or four, after the cabarets had closed. And they'd run til about seven or eight o'clock in the morning in those days, see. And then, you see, what made the breakfast dance was the beautiful chorus girls, because we did have some beautiful chorus girls in those days, you see. And when these girls come in -- of course there wouldn't have been any breakfast dance if these girls hadn't showed up. And the beauties of Harlem. And they had, we had beauties. I don't know where they are now, doing some other kind of work. But they were around in those days. And it was

enough to see them -- a guy used to say, "There's a recess in heaven, and all the angels are down here." Well, that made the thing, you see. There wasn't nothing wrong going on. It was just we'd come there and dance and talk and try to build up our future. All kinds of wrong happening in that future, but there it wasn't, there. There it was very straight.
